cluster.title: Cluster credential sharing
cluster.intro: Share ONLY credentials (tokens/cookies/secrets) between manually-paired storages on different nodes, in real time. Nodes authenticate with a shared key; all traffic is end-to-end encrypted. Peers auto-discover each other. Disabled by default.
cluster.key_hint: Every node in the cluster must use the exact same key. It both authenticates membership and encrypts all traffic. Leave blank to keep the current key.
cluster.key_placeholder: leave blank to keep current key
cluster.label: This node's name
cluster.label_hint: A friendly name shown for this node on every node's cluster panel.
cluster.addr_hint: Optional. Advertising a reachable base URL lets other nodes auto-discover and dial this node. Leave empty for nodes behind NAT.
cluster.seeds_hint: Optional. One base URL per line to dial when first joining a cluster; the rest of the mesh is then discovered automatically.
cluster.apply_remote_hint: When on, this node updates its own storages with credentials shared by group peers. Off = share-only.
cluster.groups_hint: Each group links storages across nodes that should share one credential (e.g. the same account mounted on several nodes). Only the credential is synced — every other setting stays local to each node.
cluster.no_groups: No sync groups yet. Create one and add the storages that share an account.
